title: Captum engineering comparison: resource measurement (C1-min)

decisions.scope: C1-min: runtime, memory, GPU, and storage of the existing synthetic-shortcut comparison, plus a claim-narrowing draft (section 9.4). C1-std (ImageNet subset, second implementation) is decided by the author after C1-min (implementation plan section 12 item 4; default: not run).
decisions.budget: about 3-5 min per Captum repeat and 40-60 min per SSAT repeat from the stored run times; about 3 h for 3 repeats

workflows.ssat: experiments/synthetic_shortcut/ run_audit.py, evaluate_accuracy.py, evaluate.py, run_threshold_validation_full.py (shortcut, normal), generate_report.py (shortcut, normal), crop-free checkpoints
workflows.unchanged: No workflow code, config, or ssat default is modified; each workflow keeps its own batch size and worker count.

measurement.order: Captum then SSAT on repeats 0 and 2, SSAT then Captum on repeat 1
measurement.wrapper: measure_step (experiments/benchmark_runtime_storage/run_benchmark.py, loaded by path): wall time, return code, peak RSS of the largest child process
measurement.additional: nvidia-smi memory.used and utilization.gpu every 0.2 s per command; idle GPU memory (median of 10 polls) and the compute-process list before each workflow; summed RSS of all descendant processes every 0.5 s per command
measurement.storage: bytes per top-level output entry after the last command
measurement.host: nothing else runs in the container; the host desktop session stays open as in A4

reported_measures: end-to-end wall time and its audit / analysis + report split
wall time per perturbed item (Captum 291,200 raw rows; SSAT 310,400 perturbed items, see command_map.md)
peak host RSS: largest process and summed process tree
peak GPU memory: device total and total minus the idle baseline; mean GPU utilization during the audit stage
storage by content: raw observations, metrics, analysis tables, report files

ssat_required.verdicts: Q1-Q5 pass flags, patch ranks, Q4 reproduced operators, and accuracy.json equal to experiments/synthetic_shortcut/results_crop_free/{verdicts,accuracy}.json; Q2 multiplier within 1e-3 relative

verification.ssat_informational: reliability grade counts per run against results_crop_free/analysis/<run>/reliability.parquet
verification.on_failure: reported as found; measurements are not repeated to obtain a match
